visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Compass/Redfin/SIR About on STRUCTURE, not scale. OPEN on the firm story (small boutique brokerage · all of Central Oregon · help clients buy and sell) plus an optional Bend office exterior / mission band. Then client reviews as the primary proof (Google score + featured quote — never press). Then dated local closings. Then Contact four-up Call|Text|Email|Schedule. Then office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 + firm OREA. Then a compact inquiry that GET-submits to Contact. FAIL if the page opens on brokers' faces, three equal broker Cards, or a Meet-the-Team dump. Brokers belong on /team only. About is the brokerage, not Meet the Team. Skip coast-to-coast, Redfin fee, and Rocket copy. Never invent MOS, prices, or licenses.

competitiveBrief.source: Matt 2026-09-12 / 2026-09-14 lock. About is the brokerage story. Brokers belong on /team. Evidence quotes required — a lone competitiveBriefPass boolean is refuse.
competitiveBrief.productLock: firm story + reviews + closings + Call|Text|Email|Schedule + office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 + firm OREA + inquiry→/contact. No broker roster on About.
competitiveBrief.refuse: AboutFaces, AboutTeamTeaser, Meet-the-Team dump, broker Cards, AvatarGroup. Looking that invents past this checklist. Lone boolean competitiveBriefPass without competitiveBriefEvidence.

beats.text: Firm story opens the page: one plain boutique Central Oregon buy-and-sell sentence. Not a staccato three-liner. Not a staff-directory fold.
Brokers are not on About. No broker Cards, roster dump, Meet-the-Team band, or AboutTeamTeaser. Brokers belong on /team only.
Firm reviews as words (V3Proof) plus dated local closings as a carousel of recorded sales. Never invent MOS.
Equal four-up reach: Call, Text, Email, Schedule. No Call-dominant lead.
Office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 is on the page. Optional exterior hero of that office.
Firm OREA license is on the page. One-line inquiry GET-submits to /contact.
Navy and cream only. Redfin is the layout and interaction reference, not a second palette.
Catalog interactions are real: closings carousel (shadcn carousel + Card) and inquiry input. Avatar-import plus cream CSS is not a demo match.

note: SITE-90 2026-09-14 Matt lock. About = brokerage, not Meet the Team. Brokers belong on /team only. requiredComponents opener is AboutFirm, not AboutFaces, not AboutTeamTeaser. requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (cream under the firm-story hero, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFirm
requiredComponents.section: OPENS THE PAGE. Firm story + mood: optional full-bleed Bend office exterior (115 NW Oregon Ave #2, never the sofa) with H1 and one purpose line — small boutique brokerage, all of Central Oregon, help buy and sell. Navy/cream. NOT three broker Cards. NOT Meet the Team. Do not hang a thin Google score link on the hero; the primary reviews beat is the V3Proof band that follows.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: PRIMARY client-reviews proof, immediately after the firm hero. Display-scale Google score + featured quote as words (headingLevel 2), door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews). Must read as the first proof band — not a thin score link that loses to closings or CTA. Do not muddle with press. Do not invent a rating. The count and average are sourced or omitted.

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: SALES PROOF. Recent local closings as V3Carousel / shadcn carousel (Card slides: photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, close date, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). Dated sold homes from the firm record. Not national scale counts. Never invent MOS or prices. Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #reach equal four-up: Call | Text | Email | Schedule (Sotheby G1). No v3-doors--lead. V3OnDuty hours sit above the four doors. Replaces the seven-row contact list SITE-48 removed.

requiredComponents.name: AboutOffice
requiredComponents.section: Bend office 115 NW Oregon Ave #2 and firm OREA on the fold. shadcn Card. One door to /team. No faces, no roster, no per-broker CTAs.

requiredComponents.name: AboutInquiry
requiredComponents.section: One short inquiry on About. Native GET to /contact?inquiry=. Label Send a message. Not a second ContactAsk. Full form stays on Contact.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Once: #about, late — a short origin plus the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, never a KPI Instrument. The second instance (#who, seven contact rows as the fold) was deleted by SITE-48; the reach it carried is the V3Doors reach control.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with the three edges /about has not offered yet (Value my home, Homes for sale, Central Oregon housing market) in the left rail. Replaces the closing V3Quiet 2026-09-02: as prose it measured 1,491px at 1440 with 8 paragraphs, no figure and no control, which is the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name, and four of those paragraphs restated a section above them. The D11 mission sentence went with them — VOICE.md permits it on About and requires it nowhere, and it opened on smallness positioning. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: our published booking hours against the Pacific clock, from the same crm_company_settings.booking_hours rows /book offers time from. NEVER a reply-time figure — see components/site/v3/V3OnDuty.view.ts and SITE-09.

deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. AboutFirm already uses the office exterior as the mood hero; a second Stage would restage the same photo.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Licenses are one sourced Quiet line (firm + PB), not a KPI hero.
